notes: Agent mode: switch it on in a chat and your AI makes the changes for you. It adds classes and their times, books study time, makes flashcards exactly how you ask, logs grades and sets reminders, and one tap undoes it all.
A rainbow glow runs around ATLAS while the agent is working on your desk.
Link Google Classroom: one click on a computer, or copy and paste on a phone, brings in your classes and everything due. Run it again and it updates due dates and checks off what you turned in.
Move your desk to another account: in Settings under Account and devices. You sign in to both, and nothing passes through anyone else.
A nudge to start big work two days before it's due, and reminders the agent sets for you.
